crossrefs.text: Pay close attention to everything I have said to you. You must not invoke the names of other gods; they must not be heard on your lips.
So you are not to associate with these nations that remain among you. You must not call on the names of their gods or swear by them, and you must not serve them or bow down to them.
Whom have I in heaven but You? And on earth I desire no one besides You.
You will keep in perfect peace the steadfast of mind, because he trusts in You.
Trust in the LORD forever, because GOD the LORD is the Rock eternal.
Many are the sorrows of the wicked, but loving devotion surrounds him who trusts in the LORD.
Be merciful to me, O God, for men are hounding me; all day they press their attack.
All worshipers of images are put to shame— those who boast in idols. Worship Him, all you gods!
David says about Him: ‘I saw the Lord always before me; because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
You have made known to me the paths of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence.’
He alone is my rock and my salvation; He is my fortress; I will not be shaken.
The LORD is your keeper; the LORD is the shade on your right hand.
Yet I am always with You; You hold my right hand.
My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
The Lord is at Your right hand; He will crush kings in the day of His wrath.
For He stands at the right hand of the needy one, to save him from the condemners of his soul.
You have made known to me the paths of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence.’
Now to Him who is able to keep you from stumbling and to present you unblemished in His glorious presence, with great joy—
because You will not abandon my soul to Hades, nor will You let Your Holy One see decay.
Foreseeing this, David spoke about the resurrection of the Christ, that He was not abandoned to Hades, nor did His body see decay.
How precious is Your loving devotion, O God, that the children of men take refuge in the shadow of Your wings!
They feast on the abundance of Your house, and You give them drink from Your river of delights.
For this reason, they are before the throne of God and serve Him day and night in His temple; and the One seated on the throne will spread His tabernacle over them.
For the Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd. ‘He will lead them to springs of living water,’ and ‘God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.’”

notes.title: You will not abandon me to the grave
The holy and sure blessings of David
